targets.starship: Find contacts compatible with starship-scale artificial signatures.
targets.shuttle: Find smaller craft with weaker or more localized artificial signatures.
targets.probe_beacon: Find probes, beacons or small artificial emitters.
targets.artificial_object: Find constructed objects even when unidentified.
targets.energy_source: Find energy emissions regardless of source classification.
targets.warp_signature: Find active or residual warp signatures.
targets.signal_transponder: Find transmissions, beacons or transponder codes.
targets.custom_signature: Advanced search from operator-defined signature criteria.

sensitivity.tradeoff: Higher sensitivity increases noise, doubtful contacts and false positives.

parameters.resolution: Controls desired detail for candidate observations.
parameters.criteria: Additional properties used to rank or filter compatible candidates.

world_rule: Search queries authoritative materialized world state and never creates the sought target.

conceptual_difference.scan: Observe an area to discover what is there.
conceptual_difference.search: Look for something matching known or chosen criteria.
